strings.sys.journal.person.elena.name: Elena Weiss
strings.sys.journal.person.elena.note: The Commission’s interpreter. Notes every place where the language versions of Annex C disagree. Her brother is “on a list”.
strings.sys.journal.person.border_officer.name: Border officer in Veltrava
strings.sys.journal.person.border_officer.note: Checks the delegations at the station. The words are not his business; the stamp is.
strings.sys.journal.person.conductor.name: Conductor of the Corridor Express
strings.sys.journal.person.conductor.note: A railwayman from the Reich. Counts wagons, not files – and knows that a van like that rides along every week.
strings.sys.journal.person.kessler.name: Gerhard Kessler
strings.sys.journal.person.kessler.note: Heads the Reich delegation. Wants plans from his draughtsman – no opinions, no questions.
strings.sys.journal.person.voronova.name: Lidia Voronova
strings.sys.journal.person.voronova.note: Heads the Soviet railway delegation. Believes in trains that bring bread.
strings.sys.journal.person.typist.name: Frau Brunner
strings.sys.journal.person.typist.note: Types the session minutes in three languages in the minutes office.
strings.sys.journal.person.journalist.name: Nils Ekdahl
strings.sys.journal.person.journalist.note: Swedish correspondent. Looking for someone to show him a drawing that isn’t right.
